build_paws_wiki_dataset_builder: build a TensorFlow dataset builder for the PAWS Wiki paraphrase identification dataset
create_paws_wiki_config: create a PawsWikiConfig builder config with a specified subset and tokenized or raw text mode
test_builder_info: test the Builder _info method to verify dataset schema with sentence1, sentence2, and label features
review_split_generators: review the Builder _split_generators method to download and map dataset splits for labeled and unlabeled subsets
summarize_generate_examples: summarize the Builder _generate_examples method that yields paraphrase pairs with tokenized or raw texts and labels
